summary: Keep replicated arrangement edits with unknown operation tags or placement subject families retryable instead of rejecting them.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection recovery is triggered. Existing arrangement claims keep their meaning; the API does not wait for recovery.

schema.detail: No table, index or storage-version change; the storage digest is unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change and no coordinated member upgrade is required.

compatibility.detail: The supported arrangement operation tags are part of the generated schema, and the shared projection layout name (SHARED_PROJECTION_LAYOUT) changes, so the claim-vocabulary digest and the replication schema digest differ from the previous release. Members on the old and the new build carry different digests until all run the new build; this is the usual compatibility-digest difference in a mixed-build fleet, not data loss. The new build retains unknown operation tags and unknown placement subject families on replicated arrangement.edited claims as retryable unknown-claim-field records instead of rejecting them, while local edits still refuse them.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart; no migration or replay is added.

manual.detail: No setting, store repair or manual step is required.

recovery.detail: Revert is supported: no persisted state or migration is introduced, so the previous binary can be swapped back. Retryable records retained for unknown operations are processed once a build that supports them runs.
